data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of the year is taken from the Technical Provisions / Claims Outstanding balance (prior year column). The report does not present a clear, single gross prior-year movement (gross prior year reserve movement) figure in the accessible notes or narrative, so no quantified prior-year development could be extracted with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Provisions table (Balance at 1 January) - table values are presented in GBP '000 so converted to millions. A clear GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was not identifiable in the available pages/images; narrative references to 'net' movements appear but a gross figure was not located. No claims development triangle was found in the accessible images. Page numbers are approximate based on the document footer scanned images.
